levelSelect.title: Laundry days
card.t1_bleed: Bright colors can run onto other clothes.
card.t2_size: Aim for a good fill. But wet clothes swell.
card.t3_household: Sheets and towels wash by color too.
card.t3_rags: Rags are dirty. Keep them away from clean clothes.
card.t4_bags: Small things slip away. Put them in a bag.
